questions.q: The technicians ______ the network for six hours, and they still have not found the problem. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: for six hours＋到現在還沒找到，從過去一路做到現在，用現在完成進行式。

questions.q: Ms. Wu ______ eight contracts this month. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 有數量（eight contracts），講做完了幾份，用現在完成式。

opts: We have been knowing Mr. Grant for years.
We have known Mr. Grant for years.
I've been living here for ten years.
questions.exp: know 是心理狀態動詞，一般不用進行式；其他三句都正確。

questions.q: When the manager arrived, the customers ______ for 40 minutes. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 參考點在過去（經理抵達時），一路等到那時，用過去完成進行式。

questions.q: 同事說印表機沒紙了，你當下決定去拿，該怎麼說？
opts: I'm getting some paper next week.
I'm about to get some paper tomorrow.
questions.exp: 說話當下才做的決定用 will；be about to 不配時間詞。

questions.q: The train to Tainan ______ at 7:15 tomorrow, according to the timetable. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 照時刻表的未來用現在簡單式；be about to 不配具體時間。

questions.q: As soon as the shipment ______, we will contact you. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: as soon as 子句講未來用現在式，will 只放在主要子句。

questions.q: 下面哪一句的 will 用法正確？
opts: I wonder when the new laptops will arrive.
Unless you'll pay now, we can't hold the room.
Please wait here until the manager will come.
When the office will open, we'll move in.
questions.exp: 第一句的 when 是疑問詞（什麼時候），可以接 will；unless、until 與表示「在……時」的 when 後面都不用 will。

questions.q: By next June, Mr. Ong ______ here for 20 years. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: By next June 是未來的參考點，強調持續到那時有多久，用未來完成進行式。

questions.q: The new CEO ______ arrive at 2 p.m. on Monday. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 有具體時間的預定時程用 be due to＋原形；be about to 不配時間詞，due to 前面少了 be。
